title: Everyone hated Friend’s AI necklace, so it came back at double the price

content_html:
The AI necklace that a chunk of New York wanted gone is back, and this time it talks. Friend, the pendant that listens to your day and pipes up with commentary, has re-launched with a speaker so it can reply out loud. It also costs twice as much.

The original Friend messaged you like a needy group chat of one. The new version, which founder Avi Schiffmann is calling “Friend 2.0,” adds spoken replies. That single feature has apparently doubled the price, from $129 to $249, The Verge reported.

The $249 buys the hardware outright, but there is a catch. Friend’s memories of you last just 30 days unless you pay $9.99 a month to keep them. Its voice and personality are fixed, and the company pledges never to push an update that erases who a companion has become.

A quick recap, for the lucky

If you missed Friend the first time, here is the short version. Schiffmann’s startup spent $1.8m of its $2.5m in funding just to buy the friend.com domain. It then covered the New York subway in adverts selling artificial companionship.

The city did not take it well. About nine months ago, protesters gathered to rail against the ads and the broader creep of always-on AI into human relationships. Friend was the most visible target in town, so it wore the backlash. Schiffmann leaned in, promoting the protest online and turning up to it in person.

The pitch, and the problem

The relaunch ad shows two people confiding very personal problems to their pendants. That is the whole proposition. It is a wearable that is always listening, always ready to respond, and now always ready to talk back. It is companionship as a subscription, worn around the neck.

The trouble is that the core objection has not changed, only the volume. Critics of these devices, including Signal’s Meredith Whittaker, keep making the same point: AI chatbots are not friends. A microphone on your chest, feeding a model that offers emotional support it cannot feel, raises the same privacy and dependence questions it always did.

Those questions are not going away. Young people are leaning on AI for conversation, and the public remains wary of exactly this kind of intimacy with a machine. Even China has started pulling its AI companions.

Schiffmann seems unbothered. He posted the new ad with the confidence of a founder who has decided that outrage is a marketing plan. Whether a talking, pricier Friend wins over the people who mocked the silent, cheaper one is the open question. “I’m sure things will go much better this time,” as The Verge put it, dryly.

content_html_zh:
纽约很多人都想消失的人工智能项链又回来了，而且这次它会说话。 朋友，这款可以聆听您的一天并发出评论的吊坠已重新推出，带有扬声器，因此它可以大声回复。 它的成本也是两倍。

最初的朋友给你发消息就像一个有需要的人的群聊。 创始人阿维·希夫曼 (Avi Schiffmann) 称之为“朋友 2.0”的新版本增加了语音回复。 据 The Verge 报道，这一单一功能显然使价格翻了一番，从 129 美元涨到 249 美元。

249 美元可以直接购买硬件，但有一个问题。 朋友对你的记忆只能持续 30 天，除非你每月支付 9.99 美元来保留它们。 它的声音和个性是固定的，该公司承诺永远不会推出抹去同伴身份的更新。

快速回顾一下，幸运者

如果您第一次错过了《老友记》，这里是简短版本。 Schiffmann 的初创公司花费了 250 万美元资金中的 180 万美元来购买friend.com 域名。 然后，它在纽约地铁上铺满了出售人工陪伴的广告。

这座城市并没有很好地接受这一点。 大约九个月前，抗议者聚集在一起，抗议这些广告以及永远在线的人工智能更广泛地渗透到人际关系中。 朋友是城里最明显的目标，所以它引起了强烈的反对。 希夫曼倾身参与，在网上宣传抗议活动并亲自出席。

球场和问题

重新推出的广告显示两个人向他们的吊坠倾诉非常个人的问题。 这就是整个命题。 它是一款始终在倾听、随时准备响应、现在随时准备回复的可穿戴设备。 它是作为订阅的陪伴，戴在脖子上。

麻烦的是，核心反对意见没有改变，只是数量改变了。 这些设备的批评者，包括 Signal 的梅雷迪思·惠特克 (Meredith Whittaker)，不断提出同一观点：人工智能聊天机器人不是朋友。 胸前的麦克风为模型提供了它无法感受到的情感支持，却引发了与往常一样的隐私和依赖性问题。

这些问题不会消失。 年轻人依赖人工智能进行对话，而公众对与机器的这种亲密关系仍然保持警惕。 甚至中国也开始拉动其人工智能伙伴。

希夫曼似乎并不在意。 他带着一位创始人的信心发布了新广告，这位创始人认为愤怒是一种营销计划。 一个会说话的、价格较高的朋友是否会赢得那些嘲笑沉默的、价格较低的朋友的人，这是一个悬而未决的问题。 “我确信这次事情会好得多，”The Verge 冷冷地说。
